name: doc-meeting-notes
description: Turns a transcript or rough notes into a Meeting Record of decisions with who decided, actions with one owner and a date, and open questions with who answers, plus a same-day send line for corrections. Use for "run doc-meeting-notes", "write up this meeting", "meeting notes from this transcript", "what did we decide", "action items with owners", "minutes for the product review", "who agreed to what", "send the notes today", part of the Claude Docs for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
